name: girl-next-door-cafe-snapshot
image_purpose: Everyday lifestyle and cafe social content

prompt.project_info: Create an authentic imperfect smartphone snapshot of an approved adult woman quietly using her phone at a nighttime rooftop cafe.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult Indonesian woman with long straight brown hair and a relaxed natural expression, seated casually in a plain black long-sleeved top. She holds a drink in one hand and a phone in the other, focused on the screen.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-wide candid framing from slightly to the side, subject a little smaller and imperfectly balanced, upper body and wooden table visible. Include rooftop railing, string lights, other patrons, distant Jakarta buildings, handbag, and a smartwatch without readable logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh uneven rooftop cafe lights and city lights, blown highlights, deep shadows, imperfect white balance, visible digital noise and slight motion blur.
prompt.technical_specs: Low-end smartphone look, handheld, night exposure, limited dynamic range, realistic grain, non-cinematic candid finish, no artificial bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An authentic imperfect nighttime rooftop cafe snapshot of one approved adult Indonesian woman with long straight brown hair and a relaxed natural expression, seated casually in a plain black long-sleeved top. She holds a drink in one hand and a phone in the other, focused on the screen. Slight side angle, medium-wide unbalanced framing, wooden table, rooftop railing, string lights, casual patrons, distant Jakarta buildings, handbag and smartwatch without readable logos.
